The '''Moorjhone system'''<ref name="EAOC" /> was a trinary<ref name="Death Sentence 1" /> [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorjhone]].<ref name="EAOC" />
